rule: a built-in row shows where it runs, not a host
patch:
--- a/apps/android/core/src/main/kotlin/app/marquee/core/AddonsCopy.kt
+++ b/apps/android/core/src/main/kotlin/app/marquee/core/AddonsCopy.kt
@@ -15 +15 @@
-    fun caption(addon: AddonInfo): String = "${if (addon.builtIn) BUILT_IN else addon.host} · ${addon.version}"
+    fun caption(addon: AddonInfo): String = "${addon.host} · ${addon.version}"
failing: AddonsCopyTest > a built-in row says where it runs, never a host: org.junit.ComparisonFailure: expected:<[Built into Marquee, runs on this devic]e · 1.1.1> but was:<[tta.exampl]e · 1.1.1>
change: feat(android): built-in addon line and TurkceAltyazi credit

patch:

@@ -12 +12 @@
-        "Turkish subtitles from TurkceAltyazi.org, fetched by this device when you play."
+        "Turkish subtitles from TurkceAltyazi.org, fetched when you play."
failing: AddonsCopyTest > About credits TurkceAltyazi as the plan words it: org.junit.ComparisonFailure: expected:<...ltyazi.org, fetched [by this device ]when you play.> but was:<...ltyazi.org, fetched []when you play.>
